result.summary: The interface is generally functional but exhibits minor styling and content redundancy issues.

issues.description: Insufficient color contrast for the subtext within the green promotional banner.
issues.suggestion: Increase the lightness or weight of the subtext to improve readability against the dark green.

issues.description: Redundant delivery fee information appearing both as a badge and in the text description on restaurant cards.
issues.suggestion: Remove the repetitive text to declutter the restaurant information section.
